subject: QBR renewal demo — priority queue & exec coverage patch
messages:
From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>
To: Emma Zhao <emma@brightgrid.io>
Cc: Sam Lee <sam.lee@brightgrid.io>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-02-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: QBR renewal demo — priority queue & exec coverage patch

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the quick chat last week. As we get the renewal QBR on the calendar, wanted to propose two short windows (90 minutes total) and confirm which tracks you want prioritized so we staff the right execs:

Proposed slots (ET):
 - Tue 2/28, 15:00–16:30 ET (product deep-dive + exec Q&A)
 - Thu 3/2, 10:00–11:30 ET (ops + deployment walkthrough)

Draft agenda attached (qbr_agenda_v1.pdf). High-level ask: do you want the CTO/VP Eng present for the product segment, or should we reserve time for a breakout? If CTO is attending we’ll have Ben Carter join as the exec lead; otherwise we’ll run the product session with senior PMs.

If neither window works, share two preferred slots and we’ll do our best to match. Also looping Sam from BrightGrid to include procurement/PO owner on timeline expectations.

Next steps: confirm preferred slot + priority track by EOD Tuesday and we’ll lock travel/recording permissions.

—Ethan
Ethan Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ethan.park@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

Attachment: qbr_agenda_v1.pdf

From: Emma Zhao <emma@brightgrid.io>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Lee <sam.lee@brightgrid.io>
Date: 2028-02-19T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR renewal demo — priority queue & exec coverage patch

Ethan —

Appreciate the options. Our calendars are pretty tight that week; CTO can only make small windows on Tue afternoon (short notice) and prefers the product + roadmap session (priority 1). Procurement (Sam) also asked for a PO timeline — can you confirm whether we need the PO before the demo or if post-demo is acceptable for a renewal exercise?

If Tue 2/28 15:00–16:30 ET is the best fit for the CTO to join, we’ll prioritize that. If you can shorten the demo to 60–75 minutes focused on the roadmap and save the deployment deep-dive for a follow-up, that would help.

Also include any pre-demo ask for the CTO (e.g., 1–2 bullet briefing on new infra/latency gains) so they can prep.

Thanks —
Emma Zhao
Customer Success Director, BrightGrid
emma@brightgrid.io

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Emma Zhao <emma@brightgrid.io>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sam Lee <sam.lee@brightgrid.io>
Date: 2028-02-20T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR renewal demo — priority queue & exec coverage patch

Emma / Team —

Looping in Ben (our Head of Product) who can cover the CTO Q&A and commit to the 2/28 slot if that works for you. We can compress the session to 75 minutes and focus the first 45 minutes on roadmap + latency/perf improvements (two slides CTO will want), then 30 minutes for exec Q&A and next steps.

Fallback plan if CTO can’t make it: Ben will run the session, and we’ll record the first 20 minutes where we call out the infra improvements (low-latency case study + 99th percentile numbers) so CTO can watch asynchronously.

Operational asks from our side:
 - Confirm final attendance list by Friday so we can lock rooms and recording permissions.
 - If procurement needs a PO to unblock internal approvals, please indicate whether an LOI/PO is required pre-demo or post-demo (Sam) — we can fast-track a PO template.
 - We’ll deliver a two-page CTO brief (one pager + 3 bullets on infra) by EOD 2/24 if that helps prep.

If 2/28 15:00 ET is confirmed, Ben and I will join; Ethan — can you send a calendar invite with the compressed run-of-show and the recording permission checkbox? I’ve attached a short runbook template (runbook_v2.docx) we’ll use to coordinate dry-run and host handoffs.

Thanks,
Lauren
Senior Renewal Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emma Zhao <emma@brightgrid.io>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Sam Lee <sam.lee@brightgrid.io>
Date: 2028-02-22T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Final: QBR demo scheduling + pre-demo deliverables (PO & runbook)

Emma / Sam —

Thanks for the fast replies — locking 2/28, 15:00–16:15 ET as the final slot (75 minutes). Ben will lead the product + CTO Q&A portion. Quick recap and asks below so nothing falls through the cracks:

Confirmed
 - Date/time: Tue, 28 Feb 2028, 15:00–16:15 ET (recording enabled)
 - Focus: Roadmap + latency/perf highlights (45 min) + Exec Q&A (30 min)
 - Exec coverage: Ben Carter (Redwood Head of Product) — confirmed

Pre-demo deliverables (owners & deadlines)
 - Two-page CTO brief (Ethan) — due 2028-02-24 EOD
 - Run-of-show + recording check (Lauren) — invite to be sent by 2028-02-23
 - Procurement: Sam — please confirm whether BrightGrid needs a PO pre-demo. If yes, we’ll push PO_BrightGrid_v1.pdf as an official template; if post-demo is OK, confirm expected sign date.

Attachments: runbook_v2.docx, PO_BrightGrid_v1.pdf (stubs attached for procurement).

Related links:
 - HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/39502/BG-2028-42
 - DocuSign PO (if needed): https://docusign.net/brightgrid/ABC123

If everything looks good I’ll send the firm calendar invite and a short dry-run note for Thursday 2/25, 11:00–11:30 PT (recording hosts only).

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Renewal Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
